snippet.title: Ware-wolf Campfire Stories - FREE Playdate game for Spooky season OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
https://ledbetter-games.itch.io/ware-wolf

Ware-wolf Campfire Stories is a jam-type collaborative project made by devs in the Playdate community to celebrate the expanded abilities of the Pulp game environment.. and Halloween!

This is a gift to all Playdate players and also a fantastic showcase of what Pulp can do. A new Pulp Game Switcher made by Shaun Inman of Panic has been released (originally developed to help Pine come out on Playdate Catalog). This gave us the capability to drastically expand what a Pulp project can become. 

Fifteen Dev teams came together to create games in about a 10-day window and then package them into a gameplay switcher. In Ware-wolf Campfire Stories, 5 kids are sitting around a fire with their counselor telling spoooooky tales! Each story launches a separate game that you may win or lose.... with consequences. 

The counselor will remember games played and with 14 unique 'stories' you'll need to progress the night multiple times to play them all!

Trailer by Grackalope Games
https://www.instagram.com/grackalope.games/
